turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You asked for this meeting. Who decided on Owen's zero?
Then say it. Who decided on the zero?
I'm getting dozens of these essays now. What would a fair process for catching AI writing look like? What would you put in the policy?
You're asking me to write your policy? You already have one, and it says software alone doesn't establish anything. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
